evidence.observation: Growth held at 750 °C setpoint with only a small initial settle from 760 °C
Flow tracks setpoints (100 then 200 sccm) within ~1 sccm
Stable ~3.06 Torr in growth, ~4.07 Torr at higher Ar; brief 3.32 Torr blips at k=19-20
Exhaust O2 stays 3-7 ppm, no leak indication
Heater power drops to ~0% at cooldown with smooth monotonic temperature decay

args.missing_evidence: Post-run characterization (e.g., Raman/optical/AFM) of the sample to determine whether the target film grew
